image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of a vintage-style wall-mounted barometer. The instrument features a brass or gold-colored metal casing with a vertical rectangular backplate and a circular dial at the bottom. The dial has a white face with black markings and hands, surrounded by a green and gold rim. Above the main dial is a smaller, secondary circular window or gauge, also with a metallic finish. The background is a plain, light-colored wall.
